variations.title: The backup key is missing or is not a key

output: docker compose up -d --wait postgres && docker compose up -d ops

ENDGAME_BACKUP_KEY is set but is not a backup key, so no backup runs. It must be 32 random bytes written as 64 hex characters (or as 44 characters of base64); make one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. An archive opens only with the key that sealed it, so keep the one you have used before.
steps.note: The variable is named with the shape it needs, never its value, and no backup runs. With no key at all it reads "ENDGAME_BACKUP_KEY is not set, so nothing can be encrypted and no backup runs." and the same shape. The compose progress lines are left out.
